contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ DN GRATIANVS PF AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian. Mint is Arles, AD 375-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. See LRBC p.56, no.533. Obverse legend reads DN GRATIANVS PF AVG. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TCON.
